info.name: Abstract API Phone Validation
info.description: Validate and verify a phone number with Abstract API's Phone Number Validation & Verification API. A single GET endpoint returns validity, local and international formats, country, registered location, line type, and carrier. Base URL: https://phonevalidation.abstractapi.com/v1. Authenticated with an api_key query parameter; the number is passed via the phone query parameter in E.164 format. Endpoint, method, and auth live-confirmed 2026-07-12.

item.name: Validate and verify a phone number

query.description: Your Abstract API Phone Validation API key.
The phone number to validate, ideally in E.164 format.

request.description: Validates a single phone number and returns validity, local and international formats, country, registered location, line type, and carrier.

item.name: Validate a number with a country hint

query.description: Your Abstract API Phone Validation API key.
A phone number without an international dialing code.
Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to interpret the number.

request.description: Validates a number supplied without a country code, using the optional country parameter as a hint. The country parameter is modeled from Abstract API documentation.
